proof:
intro x
show (-1 * x) ^ (2 * n + 1) * √(4 * (v : ℝ) - (-1 * x) ^ 2)
    = -(x ^ (2 * n + 1) * √(4 * (v : ℝ) - x ^ 2))
have harg : (4 * (v : ℝ) - (-1 * x) ^ 2) = 4 * (v : ℝ) - x ^ 2 := by ring
have hpow : (-1 * x : ℝ) ^ (2 * n + 1) = -(x ^ (2 * n + 1)) := by
  have heq : (-1 * x : ℝ) = -x := by ring
  rw [heq, Odd.neg_pow (⟨n, rfl⟩ : Odd (2 * n + 1))]
rw [harg, hpow]
ring
